thread:
omar: FYI customer (Acme Corp) reported a 3-5x latency spike after bumping to py-sdk 1.37. They were using our Dedicated endpoint.

omar: Quick summary — their app passed `batch_size=8` into the client for low-latency small batches, but after upgrade we see huge requests (thousands of items) being sent and single-request latencies ballooning. Looks like a param rename in the SDK that silently stopped honoring the old name.

alyssa: Oof. Do we have repro steps + minimal code? Which model + route? Any stack traces/headers?

omar: Repro I ran locally (fast fail):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)
# previously worked to keep small batches
resp = client.embeddings.batch_create(inputs=[...], batch_size=8)
```
After 1.37 that `batch_size` was ignored. Server logs show single request with ~1200 inputs. Attached logs: `trace_id=tz-8f12`, `x-redwood-received-batch=1203`.

alyssa: Can you confirm what happens if you explicitly pass `max_batch_items` (the new name)?

omar: Good call — if I pass `max_batch_items=8` it works. So it's a rename without aliasing the old name or warning. Customer hit this in prod when their dependency tree pulled 1.37 via `>=1.36`.

julia: Thanks — two immediate action items: 1) Escalate to SDK patch to reintroduce alias + a deprecation warning (patch release 1.37.1). 2) Customer workaround: pin to `redwood-sdk-python==1.36.*` or change callers to `max_batch_items`. Can we confirm a rollout ETA? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar: I've advised the customer to pin to 1.36 and added `max_batch_items` to their call for immediate mitigation. They're currently on Dedicated and saw billing/latency impact; they've asked for any credit for the window (escalated to CS).

ci-bot: Created issue redwood/sdk-python#489: "preserve `batch_size` alias, warn on rename" and assigned to @eng-ml. Milestone: 1.37.1.

alyssa: Can eng take a quick patch that logs a warning when unknown kwargs are passed? This silently breaking is bad. Also we should add a compatibility note to the 1.37 release notes and a suggested pin in the support KB.

julia: Agreed. I'll coordinate release notes and a KB entry. Also flagging on-call eng for monitoring to watch for other silent renames in the 1.37 series.

omar: Customer accepted pin + code change for now, wants confirmation when 1.37.1 is out so they can unpin. I'll follow up here with reproduction artifacts and the trace links. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Linked support ticket #CS-2024-1123 to SDK issue #489.

alyssa: Thanks — logging internal postmortem and adding to our SDK compatibility checklist (aliasing + warnings).
